data.text: I’m in. I commit to 15 tons today and will donate the full $15,000 to the clinic. That completes our $60,000 pledge, with Luke catching zero. I’ll also cap my catch at six tons next month, keeping our combined harvest at 30 so the lake can recover to 100. After that, let’s keep the total at or below 50 tons per month. My family taught me that caring for this village means caring for its people and the lake that feeds them. Let’s record today’s catches and confirm the clinic receives the full payment.
